original.description: A brightly burning handfire hangs across wood and iron.
original.source_roles: Every visible pixel is R255/detail. Static wood/iron holder is detail w; source primary R/W/r fire colour is not static holder colour.

palette.native_cycle: AnimatedMaterialFire uses(CurrentFrame+FrameOffset)%60,15-frame sections, ApplyColors(foreground,priority30), cosmetic offset updates native-owned. No new clock or custom animated art.
palette.holder_role: All source opaque pixels are detail. Registered body must have empty primary, full detail coverage, neutral gray luma. Do not tint holder bright flame red/yellow or bake brown into neutral.

effects.flame: Preserve existing Prefabs/Particles/TorchpostFlames, separate from flame-free tile. No new drawn flame/halo/particle texture or duplicate sprite animation.
effects.light: Native LightSource Lit=true Radius=6 remains unchanged; donor glow/fuel/heat/radius not imported.
effects.prefab_visibility: PrefabImposter.Render adds prefab only when not Disabled, RenderEvent.Visible and RenderEvent.Lit>1. Defaults X/Y/Z/Layer remain native; do not change flame anchor to fit artwork.

mapping.interpretation: Inspect actual directional wood ends and source render mapping; donor wall offsets/radius/placement are not recipient offsets.

donor_reference.role: Cardinal small wood/iron support readability, restrained edge and material shading only. Actual Core torch is a slender wood support, not a complete Qud sconce equivalent. Preserve Qud broad rim, short stem, open support gaps, source cell placement and native particle relationship.

construction_contract: Shared front width/depth/camera/component thickness must enter geometry and exact refinement prompt. Source holder covers x4..12,y16..21 only; do not enlarge to a full-cell tall torch. Unseen rim depth/back/strut arrangement are authored estimates. All new pixels remain detail role w. Keep upper cell region transparent for native flame.
